questions: How many devices did you fabricate in each of the three runs, how many did you image with the NV magnetometer, and how many showed the suppression? Was the nanowire D1 imaged as well?
If any devices or cooldowns were set aside (for example for leakage breakdown, vortex pinning or probe problems), why?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: bias fields other than B0 ~ 1 mT, r0(P) at bath temperatures other than 0.4 K and 5.6 K, gate powers above about 4.5 µW, and r0(P) for gates G2 to G5?
What does the second-best dataset look like? The r0(P) data for D2a and D2b sit in Figs. S3 and S4; could the main text show one of them next to Fig. 3a?

In Fig. 3b, r0 rises steeply with |VG| within each temperature set, and the two sets reach the same r0 at different |VG|. Could you plot r0 against VG at fixed P, for example from the constant-power runs on D3, where VG is logged while P is held fixed?

What local temperature rise would 1 to 4 µW dissipated at the gate apex produce in SiO2/Si at 0.4 K and at 5.6 K, what Tc does the film have (Table S1), and how large a shift in r0 between the two bath temperatures would a thermal model predict?
Do the IL/VG curves follow Fowler-Nordheim emission, and does r0 at fixed P change when the onset voltage drifts between curves (Fig. 1c)?
Did you measure the transport GCS on the nanowire D1, and at what gate power did its critical current vanish, so the µW powers here can be compared with transport on the same film?
